intent.zh: 确认组织健全、职责清晰、胜任力与培训体系完善
intent.en: Ensure the organization is structured, responsibilities are explicit, and competency and training systems are in place.

questions.id: org-1-组织边界与职责清晰度-r-r-跨团队接口-是否有正式组织架构-跨团队接口定义与升级路径

text.zh: 组织边界与职责清晰度（R&R、跨团队接口） 是否有正式组织架构、跨团队接口定义与升级路径？
text.en: Organizational boundaries & role clarity (R&R, cross-team interfaces): Do we maintain a formal org structure, defined interfaces, and escalation paths?

zh.1: 无正式组织架构或职责描述，跨团队接口依赖个人沟通。
zh.2: 有组织图但R&R模糊，接口人或升级路径缺乏记录。
zh.3: 形成书面R&R并发布，跨团队接口与职责有基本定义。
zh.4: 跨团队接口SLA、升级机制与例会例行执行，职责边界清晰落地。
zh.5: 基于项目复盘动态优化R&R，接口绩效与资源数据化可追踪。

en.1: No formal org structure or role descriptions; cross-team interfaces rely on ad-hoc communication.
en.2: Org chart exists but R&R is vague; interface owners or escalation paths are undocumented.
en.3: Documented and published R&R with basic definitions for cross-team interfaces and responsibilities.
en.4: Cross-team SLAs, escalation mechanisms, and cadences run consistently; role boundaries are enforced.
en.5: R&R is continuously refined via retrospectives, with interface performance and resources tracked in data.

focus: 组织架构与岗位说明书是否发布
跨团队接口人和升级路径是否明确
职责边界与权限如何维护
ask: 组织架构多长时间更新一次？
跨团队升级路径和 SLA 如何定义？
evidence: 最新组织架构图与岗位说明
接口/升级流程记录
threshold: 组织职责发布并可查询
升级路径在项目中可验证

focus: Whether the org chart and job descriptions are published
Whether cross-team interface owners and escalation paths are defined
How role boundaries and permissions are maintained
ask: How often is the org chart updated?
How are cross-team escalation paths and SLAs defined?
evidence: Latest org chart and job descriptions
Interface/escalation process records
threshold: Role responsibilities are published and discoverable
Escalation paths can be validated in projects

questions.id: org-2-关键岗位胜任力矩阵-rf-camera-emc-热-可靠性-关键岗位是否具备胜任力矩阵与资格认证

text.zh: 关键岗位胜任力矩阵（RF/Camera/EMC/热/可靠性） 关键岗位是否具备胜任力矩阵与资格认证？
text.en: Critical-role competency matrix (RF/Camera/EMC/Thermal/Reliability): Do critical roles maintain competency matrices and certifications?

zh.1: 无胜任力矩阵或岗位胜任标准，人员能力不可视。
zh.2: 有零散胜任力记录但未覆盖关键岗位或缺更新。
zh.3: 建立胜任力矩阵并定义资格标准，具备考核记录。
zh.4: 定期评审矩阵并联动培训/考证，能力缺口有闭环计划。
zh.5: 胜任力矩阵与项目需求/资源排期联动，预警能力缺口并沉淀数据。

en.1: No competency matrix or role standards; capabilities are invisible.
en.2: Fragmented competency records that miss critical roles or lack updates.
en.3: Competency matrix established with qualification standards and assessment records.
en.4: Matrix reviewed regularly with linked training/certification; capability gaps have closure plans.
en.5: Competency matrix ties into project demand and resource schedules, forecasting gaps and capturing data.

focus: 胜任力矩阵覆盖范围与定义方法（技能项、等级）
关键岗位清单及岗位胜任标准
认证/培训计划与到期管理
能力评估频率与更新机制
与项目需求/资源排期的联动
能力缺口识别、备份人/外协池
ask: 胜任力矩阵多久更新一次？由谁负责？
关键岗位资格/证书如何验真与到期提醒？
如何将项目需求映射到人员胜任力？缺口如何处理（培训/招聘/外部）？
是否建立备份人与离岗替补机制？
evidence: 胜任力矩阵样表（含技能项、等级、更新时间）
关键岗位资格清单与证书记录
培训计划、签到与考核结果
需求-人员匹配与资源排期截图
能力缺口与补齐闭环台账
threshold: 关键岗位 100% 建立胜任力标准与覆盖
矩阵≥季度更新，证书到期预警≥30天
立项前完成需求-人员匹配并闭环缺口

focus: Competency matrix scope & definition (skills, levels)
Critical role list and role competency standards
Certification/training plans and expiry management
Assessment cadence and update mechanism
Linkage to project demand & resource scheduling
Gap identification, backups, and external bench
ask: How often is the competency matrix updated and by whom?
How do you verify certificates and manage expiry reminders for critical roles?
How are project demands mapped to competencies? How are gaps handled (training/hiring/external)?
Is there a backup and backfill mechanism for absences?
evidence: Competency matrix (skills, levels, last update)
Critical-role qualification list and certificate records
Training plans, attendance, and assessment results
Demand-to-people mapping and resource schedules
Gap remediation log with closure records
threshold: 100% of critical roles have defined competency standards and are covered
Matrix updated ≥ quarterly; certificate expiry alerts ≥ 30 days
Demand-to-people matching done pre-kickoff; gaps closed before start

questions.id: org-4-领域覆盖与-dri-清单-子系统命名-dri-权限-是否维护子系统-dri-清单及权限边界

text.zh: 域/子系统 DRI 覆盖：是否维护子系统 DRI 名单、权限边界与备份安排，并能随项目/变更同步更新、快速补齐覆盖缺口？
text.en: Domain/subsystem DRI coverage: Do we maintain a subsystem DRI roster, authority boundaries, and backups, synchronized with changes and backfilling coverage gaps promptly?

zh.1: 无 DRI 清单或仅口头指定；权限边界不清；无备份安排；变更不同步。
zh.2: 有初步 DRI 名单但覆盖不全或未定义权限/备份；更新零散；缺口补位无记录。
zh.3: 维护正式 DRI 清单并定义权限边界与备份；项目可查询负责人；变更后在规定时间内完成更新。
zh.4: DRI 清单与项目/变更流程定期或自动同步（如≤48小时）；缺口补位有明确 SLA（如≤3个工作日）并留存审计记录；备份演练有效。
zh.5: DRI 清单与资源/排班/权限系统数据化联动；关键子系统覆盖率100%；具备缺位预测与预警，自动工单与权限同步；MTTA/MTTR 等指标可视并持续改进。

en.1: No DRI roster or only verbal assignments; unclear authority boundaries; no backups; changes are not synchronized.
en.2: A preliminary DRI list exists but coverage is incomplete or authority/backups are undefined; updates are ad hoc; no records of gap backfilling.
en.3: A formal DRI roster is maintained with defined authority boundaries and backups; owners are discoverable in projects; updates are completed within a defined window after changes.
en.4: The DRI roster is regularly or automatically synchronized with projects/changes (e.g., ≤48h); gap backfilling follows a clear SLA (e.g., ≤3 business days) with audit trails; backups are exercised effectively.
en.5: The DRI roster is data-linked to resourcing/scheduling/permission systems; 100% coverage on critical subsystems; proactive absence prediction and alerts; auto work orders and permission sync; MTTA/MTTR and similar metrics are visible with continuous improvement.

focus: 子系统清单与命名规范
DRI 权限边界、备份人/排班
变更同步与缺口补位时效
ask: 过去一个月有哪些 DRI 变更？如何通知并生效？
DRI 缺位时如何在多长时间内补位？
evidence: DRI 名单（含权限/备份/排班）
变更同步记录与发布渠道
缺口补位台账与时效统计
threshold: 关键子系统 100% 指定 DRI
备份命中率≥X%，补位≤Y 天

focus: Subsystem inventory & naming
DRI authority boundaries, backups/roster
Change sync and gap backfilling SLA
ask: Which DRI changes occurred last month? How were they communicated and enforced?
When a DRI is unavailable, what is the SLA for backfilling?
evidence: DRI roster (authority/backups/schedule)
Change sync records & comms
Gap backfilling log with timing stats
threshold: 100% DRI assignment on critical subsystems
Backup hit rate ≥ X%, backfill within ≤ Y days

questions.id: org-5-技术治理与决策边界-drb-ccb-stop-build-建议权-技术治理机制是否有效运行

text.zh: 技术治理与决策边界（DRB/CCB、Stop-Build 建议权） 技术治理机制是否有效运行？
text.en: Technical governance & decision boundaries (DRB/CCB, stop-build authority): Does the technical governance mechanism operate effectively?

zh.1: 无技术治理例会或决策机制，重大变更随意决策。
zh.2: 偶尔召开 DRB/CCB，但议题、参与人和结论缺章程。
zh.3: DRB/CCB 有章程与决策记录，Stop-Build 建议有依据。
zh.4: 技术治理决策与风险、度量挂钩，可触发停线与整改闭环。
zh.5: 技术治理体系数据化运行，决策与指标、知识库形成闭环。

en.1: No technical governance reviews or decision mechanisms; major changes are made ad hoc.
en.2: DRB/CCB meetings happen occasionally but lack charters, defined attendees, or documented outcomes.
en.3: DRB/CCB have charters and decision records; stop-build recommendations are evidence-based.
en.4: Technical governance decisions tie to risks and metrics, enabling line stops and corrective follow-through.
en.5: Technical governance runs on data, linking decisions, metrics, and the knowledge base in a closed loop.

focus: 组织架构与岗位说明书是否发布
跨团队接口人和升级路径是否明确
职责边界与权限如何维护
DRB/CCB 章程与议题管理
Stop-Build 建议权与执行
技术决策与指标挂钩
